articles.title: MTG-I2 completes Europe’s latest weather trio
articles.summary: The second Meteosat Third Generation Imager satellite (MTG-I2) has been launched on board Ariane 6 , flight VA270, from Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana. It will complete the first family of MTG satellites, delivering data for weather forecasting over Europe and northern Africa with unprecedented quality, quantity and frequency.

articles.title: Watch live: MTG-I2 set for liftoff
articles.summary: The next Meteosat Third Generation Imager satellite (MTG-I2) is set for liftoff on flight VA270 on an Ariane 6, from Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana. It will complete the first family of MTG satellites, which will deliver data for weather forecasting over Europe and northern Africa in unprecedented detail. The launch will be broadcast on Thursday, 27 August, on ESA WebTV.
